mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, signaled by a 3% or greater month-over-month decline in the INDPRO index, indicates a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as companies struggle with input constraints and rising costs.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 55% of instances following a triggered INDPRO decline, indicating the market is shrugging off the supply shock.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate, especially if the UNRATE increases by more than 0.5 percentage points over a 3-month period, signals a weakening labor market and slowing consumer demand that will weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Consumer confidence (Conference Board index) rises by more than 5 points during the signal period, indicating the labor market weakness is not dampening consumer spirits.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will slow economic growth and weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth accelerates by more than 1% annualized during the signal period, indicating the economy is resistant to the restrictive policy.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 10-year Treasury yield rises by more than 50 basis points during the signal period, indicating that rising mortgage rates will dampen the housing strength.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 300,000 jobs in a single month, it signals a surging labor market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Initial jobless claims (ICSA) rise by more than 30,000 in the week following the payroll report, indicating that the labor market strength may be fleeting.

mechanism_narrative: When real consumer spending (RSAFS) declines by more than 1% month-over-month, and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 7%, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 posts positive returns in more than 40% of the 20-day periods following the trigger, indicating that the market is not concerned about the consumer weakness.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% year-over-year, and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals an inflationary environment that will erode the purchasing power of fixed-income assets and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors seek inflation hedges.
failure_condition: The 5-year breakeven inflation rate (T5YIE) declines by more than 50 basis points during the signal period, indicating that the market expects the inflationary pressures to be transitory.
